name: Pradhan Mantri Kaushal Vikas Yojana (PMKVY)
description: Flagship skill-certification scheme offering free short-term training and certification to youth.
benefits: Free training, certification, placement support, monetary reward on certification.
steps: Complete training; appear for assessment; get certificate.
